company.name: cwallet
company.shortDescription: CWallet is a licensed fintech company that offers digital wallet, payment, payroll, and remittance services.
company.description:
C Wallet Services is a a Fintech startup that provides payroll, payment and remittance services. Allowing users to receive their salary on time, providing access to e-commerce platforms including our own marketplace so users can buy and pay online even without having a bank. Daily needs like groceries and medicines can be delivered to their family’s doorstep if requested and ultimately, send money home anytime and anywhere. 

It provides financial services for the unbanked and low-income migrant workers, domestic helpers and blue collar workers. Catering mSME, Startups and home-made-business. Fast, secure, and hassle-free payments, payroll, cross border remittance mobile application.

productsAndServices.description: A mobile electronic wallet for adding funds, storing e-money, making local transfers and payments, and withdrawing funds to a Qatar bank account or through supported cash-out channels.

insights.title: Meaningful non-dilutive funding
insights.statement: 1 disclosed grants total $500,000, representing 31.35% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,628,082 to $9,148,555, a 2.52x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 39 (-5 over 90 days) and market heat at 56 (+11).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
